release_notes:
- Fixed SPECTRA_GATEWAY_PORT origin allowlisting between spectra-shell Rust HTTP gateway and spectra_web sidecar (eliminating 403 failures across AI & GitHub POST routes)
- Added Local AI auto-start on /api/ai/toggle, portable Ollama model discovery, live diagnostics.ollama telemetry & 300s upstream proxy timeout
- Fixed GitHub CLI user-space shim discovery (~/.local/share/mise/shims, ~/.local/bin), external https://*.github.com browser handoff & UI error reporting
- Added zero-dependency PNG-in-ICO decoder in spectra-shell and rebuilt Windows PE32+ binaries
